name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.6 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 24 times in 7 visits over 43 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 46 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 43 hours starting 2025-08-04, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.18 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
